body.name: certified rational spectral handle \(\mathsf C_{\mathbb Q}\)
body.construction: At each tested stage, take outward rational enclosures of the empirical covariance summaries in the fixed support coordinates, refined to the selected working precision, together with outward rational bounds for the elementary functions appearing in the statistical radii. Let \(Q=8(n^2+2n)\), which dominates the covariance inversions, primitive formations, reached sum and rank operations, repeated-invariant-subspace projectors, projector products, singular-value comparisons, and singleton encoder selections in one restarted transcript. Assign every such operation an arithmetic enclosure budget at most \(\beta=e_{\star}/(4Q)\), with the local accuracy further reduced when necessary to be at most a fixed fraction of \(g_0\), \(h_0\), or \(\tau/n\). Use fraction-free rational elimination for inversion and inertia, the certified Hermitian spectral-projector routine at the gap separating the empirical zero and positive clusters, outward-rounded rational matrix multiplication, and rational inertia bisection on the Hermitian dilation of each projector product for its largest singular value. For a nonzero singleton projector, select a column whose certified norm is maximal, normalize it with an outward rational square-root enclosure, and, if an ambient encoder is requested, multiply by the supplied rational enclosure of the canonical support frame. Increase \(p_{\mathrm{bit}}\) until every accumulated interval is strictly on one side of the public decision boundary; at the cap \(B_{\mathrm{samp}}\), return \(\bot\) if this has not happened. The resulting deterministic post-summary procedure is \(\mathsf C_{\mathbb Q}\).
